result.reason: The operative language substantially reaches the preferred position: it creates a mutual aggregate cap equal to the greater of 12 months’ paid/payable fees or USD 1 million, includes all required uncapped carve-outs, preserves the mutual consequential-damages exclusion, and excludes Company’s fee-payment obligation from the cap. The changes are confined to the liability allocation and preserve the remainder of the clause. Minor drafting issues are that the fee lookback runs from the event giving rise to the claim rather than the claim itself, and the payment clarification refers only to fees rather than all payment obligations; these do not prevent the clause from meeting at least the fallback and substantially the preferred position.
